events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54! What's your favourite track featuring that iconic voice?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album and its message still resonate. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Apple released the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, Apple unveiled the first iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit screens. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. A true icon whose music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what tracks are on your side A?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Remembering Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away 35 years ago today at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' album that pushed boundaries. What's your go-to track from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic death of The Beatles icon John Lennon, who was killed at age 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on. What's his most impactful song for you?
